title: Etcd Quorum Loss
description: A disruptive power event has left the control plane in a split state. Multiple etcd members are unhealthy, leader elections are thrashing, and API availability is collapsing under repeated retries.

incidentTicket.title: Control plane unstable after regional power event
incidentTicket.description: The cluster never recovered cleanly after a brief power interruption. Engineers report intermittent API failures and repeated control plane restarts.
incidentTicket.customerImpact: Administrative actions are unreliable, operators cannot reconcile consistently, and customer workloads are at risk if recovery steps are not sequenced carefully.
